description: This electric bike is powered by a brushless 500W motor (650W peak power) and a 42V 10.4Ah lithium-ion battery. This powerful combination delivers a top speed of up to 20 mph, making it perfect for your daily commute, leisurely park rides, or any recreational activities. For a throttle-controlled speed. Bike mode: Enjoy a traditional cycling experience. Assisted mode (EAS): Automatically adjusts electric assistance based on pedal motion and speed. Cruise mode: Maintaining a stable speed of 15.5 mph, 6.2 mph, 12.4 mph, or 19.9 mph. Booster mode: For a steady uphill speed of 3-5 mph. This city commuter e-bike features a foldable frame that allows for easy storage and transportation. The folding dimensions are 29.9" x 13.4" x 24.8" (L x W x H), and the lightweight body enhances portability, making it simple to carry or store in the trunk of your car. The display provides valuable information such as mileage, voltage, current, and time. Besides, the premium handlebars and saddle with adjustable heights, ensure agile and effortless control tailored to your comfort. This city bike is equipped with dual disk brakes for reliable stopping power, a bright headlight and reflective mirrors for increased visibility. Additionally, it also comes with a bell on the handlebar that alerts others of your presence. Product Description Are you looking for a high-performance electric bike that combines power, versatility, and convenience? Look no further than this model, which boasts a 500W brushless motor and a 42V 10.4Ah lithium-ion battery, offering a top speed of 20 mph for all your daily commutes and leisure rides. With 5 working modes, including throttle, bike, assisted (EAS), cruise, and booster, you have the flexibility to choose your preferred riding style. When it's time to store or travel, the compact foldable frame and lightweight design make it a breeze to carry or fit in your car trunk. Besides, this folding e-bike also comes with adjustable handlebars and saddle heights for added comfort and control. Safety is also a priority, with dual disk brakes, a bright headlight, reflective mirrors, and a bell for alerting others of your presence, ensuring a safe and enjoyable riding experience.
